wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.title: From the first spark to masterful spells, breakfast still brings a few mishaps. A sleepy hat stays with you through all nine levels.

levels.name: Apprentice Wizard
levels.subtitle: A patch and a first spark
levels.hat: Floppy pointed hat with a patch
levels.cape: Misty purple capelet with ties and a cream bow
levels.prop: Floating twig wand and a tiny spark
levels.motion: A late yellow star pops beside the hat tip, then settles back on it.
levels.story: The first tap is where the magic begins.

levels.name: Spark Mage
levels.subtitle: Light a flame of your own
levels.hat: Amber hatband and star badge
levels.cape: Purple capelet with a round amber clasp
levels.prop: Polished wooden wand and a little flame
levels.motion: A small cream puff rises from the chimney and turns into a star.
levels.story: What once happened by chance now follows your lead.

levels.name: Rune Mage
levels.subtitle: Give every symbol power
levels.hat: Upright pointed hat with three geometric runes
levels.cape: Silver-trimmed uniform capelet with a triangular clasp
levels.prop: Three floating rune stones
levels.motion: Three runes above the frame light up out of step; the last is upside down.
levels.story: Scattered taps have become your very first spell.

levels.name: Elemental Mage
levels.subtitle: Bring fire and water into balance
levels.hat: Two-tone elemental hatband
levels.cape: Teal and blue capelet with a water-drop clasp
levels.prop: Double-ended wand with fire and water crystals
levels.motion: A water drop chases a warm star beside the spout, outside the input area.
levels.story: You are learning to make opposing forces work together.

levels.name: Keeper of the Grimoire
levels.subtitle: A spellbook of your own
levels.hat: Gold-trimmed pointed hat with a square amethyst
levels.cape: Scholar's capelet with a cream collar and gold trim
levels.prop: Floating grimoire with a red bookmark
levels.motion: A star-shaped puff of burnt smoke rises from the recipe; the hat nods a beat late.
levels.story: Day by day, you have gathered enough to fill a book.

levels.name: Starlight Mage
levels.subtitle: Turn ordinary days into constellations
levels.hat: Crescent hat with embroidered stars and a fine gold orbital arc
levels.cape: Constellation capelet with a star clasp
levels.prop: Small brass astrolabe
levels.motion: The astrolabe turns half a step and points straight at the fish biscuit.
levels.story: Looking back, all those ordinary days have become stars.

levels.name: Sage of Time
levels.subtitle: Let time keep you company
levels.hat: Ivory hat with teal lining and a broken time ring
levels.cape: White sage's capelet with an hourglass clasp
levels.prop: Complete floating hourglass
levels.motion: A breadcrumb pauses, then drifts down; reduced motion uses a gentle fade.
levels.story: Time has never been rushing you. It has been beside you all along.

levels.name: Archmage
levels.subtitle: Bring order to the arcane
levels.hat: Geometric gold hatband, floating crown and segmented arcane ring
levels.cape: Layered purple and white capelet with an amethyst clasp
levels.prop: Diamond-crystal staff
levels.motion: Two outer book pages each turn halfway, then stop.
levels.story: Even the most complicated magic now has its place.

levels.name: Master of Magic
levels.subtitle: Many taps, a quiet confidence
levels.hat: White and gold crown hat with three crystals and a complete star ring
levels.cape: Layered white and gold capelet with a prism clasp
levels.prop: White and gold prism scepter
levels.motion: Nine panels glow warmly in turn; the burnt fish gives off one tiny star-shaped puff.
levels.story: A true master still makes progress one thoughtful tap at a time.

astronaut.name: Space Explorer
astronaut.title: From a cardboard telescope to distant galaxies, the most important mission is still delivering fish snacks on time.

levels.name: Stargazer
levels.subtitle: Telescope with a biscuit in the lens
levels.hat: Folded paper hat with a star
levels.cape: Cream capelet with planet patches
levels.prop: Telescope with a biscuit in the lens
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: A fish biscuit has claimed the telescope's lens.

levels.name: Space Cadet
levels.subtitle: Two-biscuit supply box
levels.hat: Soft blue cap with a star badge
levels.cape: Quilted blue capelet with planets
levels.prop: Two-biscuit supply box
levels.motion: A small orange star pops up above the supply bag.
levels.story: Two large fish biscuits line up in the supply box.

levels.name: Astronaut Trainee
levels.subtitle: Open biscuit supply capsule
levels.hat: Soft space cap with a flip-up lid
levels.cape: Quilted cream capelet with pipe details
levels.prop: Open biscuit supply capsule
levels.motion: The fish indicator on the backpack lights up for a beat.
levels.story: Open the capsule and a fish biscuit peeks out.

levels.name: Orbital Pilot
levels.subtitle: Orbit dial with two fish pointers
levels.hat: Goggle cap with large lenses
levels.cape: Blue star-patterned capelet with orange trim
levels.prop: Orbit dial with two fish pointers
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: Two fish-shaped pointers chase each other around the orbit.

levels.name: Spacewalker
levels.subtitle: Fish-snack pouch with a coiled tether
levels.hat: Cream helmet with twin antennas
levels.cape: Supply capelet with a thick cream collar
levels.prop: Fish-snack pouch with a coiled tether
levels.motion: The supply box's fish-tail knob twitches; a small pouch floats up and returns.
levels.story: Even in space, snacks need a sturdy tether.

levels.name: Moon Explorer
levels.subtitle: Moon-rock box with a stray cookie
levels.hat: Two-panel hat with lunar craters
levels.cape: Silver and blue capelet with lunar craters
levels.prop: Moon-rock box with a stray cookie
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: Someone has slipped a half-eaten cookie into the moon-rock samples.

levels.name: Deep-Space Navigator
levels.subtitle: Star chart with a fish destination
levels.hat: Star-biscuit antenna hat
levels.cape: Star-patterned capelet with cream trim
levels.prop: Star chart with a fish destination
levels.motion: A dot lights at the end of the dashed line and stops beside the fish.
levels.story: The destination on this deep-space chart is a fish.

levels.name: Starfleet Commander
levels.subtitle: Round supply mission dial
levels.hat: Hat with solar-panel antennas
levels.cape: Blue and white capelet with a planet clasp
levels.prop: Round supply mission dial
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: The mission dial revolves around its fish-shaped supply target.

levels.name: Galactic Pioneer
levels.subtitle: Platter of fish and star biscuits
levels.hat: Soft hat with a comet arc
levels.cape: Blue and white capelet with a comet tail
levels.prop: Platter of fish and star biscuits
levels.motion: The backpack hatch flashes once; the nine-star chart ends at the center of the platter.
levels.story: This galaxy turns out to be a platter of fish and star biscuits.

pirate.name: Seafaring Pirate
pirate.title: A very serious treasure map leads to an ever grander collection of bath toys. The captain treats every discovery with due ceremony.

levels.name: Dockside Apprentice
levels.subtitle: Bath plug tied to a mooring post
levels.hat: Red bandana with a side knot
levels.cape: Red capelet with a rope knot
levels.prop: Bath plug tied to a mooring post
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: Every voyage begins by securing the bath plug.

levels.name: Deckhand
levels.subtitle: Bath duck in a swim ring
levels.hat: Red and white striped bandana
levels.cape: Teal capelet with red and white stripes
levels.prop: Bath duck in a swim ring
levels.motion: A water drop beside the frame becomes a small dot.
levels.story: One swim ring is all this bath duck needs to declare itself a navy.

levels.name: Treasure Seeker
levels.subtitle: Small chest holding a captain's hat
levels.hat: Soft paper-boat hat with a bath duck
levels.cape: Teal capelet with an anchor patch
levels.prop: Small chest holding a captain's hat
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: The chest's greatest treasure is another captain's hat.

levels.name: Sea Navigator
levels.subtitle: Compass with a duck-bill pointer
levels.hat: Folded compass hat
levels.cape: Capelet with a compass map
levels.prop: Compass with a duck-bill pointer
levels.motion: The compass needle slips one step, then returns to the duck symbol.
levels.story: This compass finds its way with a duck's bill.

levels.name: Independent Captain
levels.subtitle: Bath-duck bathtub sailboat
levels.hat: Captain's tricorn with red cord
levels.cape: Teal capelet with a red collar and gold trim
levels.prop: Bath-duck bathtub sailboat
levels.motion: A small bubble with an anchor appears beside the flagship.
levels.story: The bath duck sets sail in its bathtub flagship.

levels.name: Ocean Captain
levels.subtitle: Barrel of bath-soap supplies
levels.hat: Hat with a folded sail corner
levels.cape: Teal capelet with cream wave trim
levels.prop: Barrel of bath-soap supplies
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: Supplies for the ocean crossing: three bubbling bottles of bath soap.

levels.name: Storm Navigator
levels.subtitle: Rain-hat duck in an umbrella boat
levels.hat: Soft captain's hat with a red tip
levels.cape: Wave-patterned capelet with a red collar and rope clasp
levels.prop: Rain-hat duck in an umbrella boat
levels.motion: Two tiny raindrops travel sideways past the umbrella and disappear.
levels.story: A duck in a rain hat turns an upside-down umbrella into a boat.

levels.name: Admiral of the Seven Seas
levels.subtitle: Fleet of three bath-duck boats
levels.hat: Fan-shaped pirate hat with waves
levels.cape: Red and white capelet with a teal collar
levels.prop: Fleet of three bath-duck boats
levels.motion: The last duck symbol lights up half a beat late.
levels.story: Three duck boats form a fleet. The last faces the wrong way.

levels.name: Legendary Pirate King
levels.subtitle: Treasure chest turned duck hot spring
levels.hat: Captain's hat with a map and gold hook
levels.cape: Map-patchwork capelet with a large bow
levels.prop: Treasure chest turned duck hot spring
levels.motion: Three warm harbor lights glow in sequence, followed by one drifting bubble.
levels.story: The legendary treasure chest becomes a hot-spring harbor for bath ducks.

ninja.name: Moonshadow Ninja
ninja.title: Stealth training keeps getting undone by sneezes, snack bags and noisy trinkets. Mastery begins with putting them away gently.

levels.name: Dojo Apprentice
levels.subtitle: Practice board with an upright leaf
levels.hat: Blue headband with a wooden peg
levels.cape: Patched blue capelet
levels.prop: Practice board with an upright leaf
levels.motion: A fine mint line flicks beside the peg.
levels.story: During fallen-leaf stealth practice, one leaf insists on standing up.

levels.name: Swift Novice
levels.subtitle: Practice board with a spring-loaded post
levels.hat: Side-tied headband with mended stitching
levels.cape: Dotted blue capelet with a large bow
levels.prop: Practice board with a spring-loaded post
levels.motion: The scarf tail sways for one beat, then stops.
levels.story: The quiet training floor has somehow acquired a giant spring.

levels.name: Shadow-Step Student
levels.subtitle: Training post on wheels
levels.hat: Headband with a bamboo scroll
levels.cape: Blue capelet with bamboo tubes and leaf tassels
levels.prop: Training post on wheels
levels.motion: A small sweat drop fades in above the post.
levels.story: The training post has wheels and makes its escape first.

levels.name: Night Scout
levels.subtitle: Spring-loaded stepping board
levels.hat: Headband with a silver cloud plate and raised tail
levels.cape: Folded blue capelet with a silver clasp
levels.prop: Spring-loaded stepping board
levels.motion: Two apricot zigzag lines flash beside the board, without sound.
levels.story: The shadow-step board has turned into a springboard.

levels.name: Moonshadow Ninja
levels.subtitle: Giant bag of crunchy fish biscuits
levels.hat: Headband with a crescent and large bow
levels.cape: Capelet with cream fleece trim and a moon clasp
levels.prop: Giant bag of crunchy fish biscuits
levels.motion: Rustle lines flash on the bag; the scarf tail immediately stops.
levels.story: Stealth meets its match in one enormous bag of crunchy fish biscuits.

levels.name: Silver-Blade Ninja
levels.subtitle: Biscuit bag sealed with a giant peg
levels.hat: Headband with a silver three-star plate
levels.cape: Blue capelet with silver-patterned trim
levels.prop: Biscuit bag sealed with a giant peg
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: A neatly trimmed biscuit bag is kept quiet by a very large wooden peg.

levels.name: Hazy-Moon Mentor
levels.subtitle: Brass bell hidden behind a leaf
levels.hat: Headband with a leaf and wooden peg
levels.cape: Blue capelet with a leaf knot
levels.prop: Brass bell hidden behind a leaf
levels.motion: An apricot pollen dot pops beside the leaf, clear of the cat's face.
levels.story: One oversized leaf tries to conceal an entire brass bell.

levels.name: Silent Master
levels.subtitle: Brass bell tucked under a blanket
levels.hat: Sleep headwrap with two soft bundles
levels.cape: Light blue sleep capelet with pompoms
levels.prop: Brass bell tucked under a blanket
levels.motion: A blanket corner lifts and settles; the bell stays silent.
levels.story: A little blanket has finally lulled the bell to sleep.

levels.name: Moonshadow Legend
levels.subtitle: Blanketed training post and biscuit bag
levels.hat: Headband with a full moon and fan bow
levels.cape: Blue capelet with gold stars and moons
levels.prop: Blanketed training post and biscuit bag
levels.motion: A mint breathing arc gently fades beside the post, without movement.
levels.story: Ultimate stealth: the post sleeps under a blanket, its snack bag tied nearby.

hero.name: City Superhero
hero.title: The uniform looks ready to save the world. The actual missions are fixing taps, bringing in laundry and opening the neighbors' jam jars.

levels.name: Neighborhood Helper
levels.subtitle: Upside-down cup and cleaning cloth
levels.hat: Red bandana with a clothes peg
levels.cape: Red capelet with a cream patch
levels.prop: Upside-down cup and cleaning cloth
levels.motion: A small yellow star appears beside the peg.
levels.story: A large peg holds up the bandana; an upside-down cup turns a cloth into a rescue scene.

levels.name: Community Guardian
levels.subtitle: Laundry-line backpack rescuing a sock
levels.hat: Thick blue and red headband with two pegs
levels.cape: Blue capelet with a red collar and two pegs
levels.prop: Laundry-line backpack rescuing a sock
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: The padded headband and laundry-line backpack are ready to rescue one little sock.

levels.name: Hero in Training
levels.subtitle: Tool bag carried by a balloon
levels.hat: Goggle hat with a balloon
levels.cape: Blue and red capelet with cream quilting
levels.prop: Tool bag carried by a balloon
levels.motion: A short yellow line lights up along the balloon string.
levels.story: One balloon lifts the goggles while another carries off the whole tool bag.

levels.name: Night Patrol Hero
levels.subtitle: Tool bag with a dripping tap
levels.hat: Rain hat with a flashlight
levels.cape: Blue rain cape with cream dots
levels.prop: Tool bag with a dripping tap
levels.motion: A water drop becomes a yellow star, then fades.
levels.story: The rain hat has a flashlight, but the rescue bag comes with a dripping tap.

levels.name: City Hero
levels.subtitle: Jam-jar rescue satchel
levels.hat: Rescue helmet made from a jam-jar lid
levels.cape: Red capelet with a blue collar and peg clasp
levels.prop: Jam-jar rescue satchel
levels.motion: Two effort lines glow beside the lid, followed by a tiny star.
levels.story: The jam lid becomes a large helmet; the entire jar is carefully packed for rescue.

levels.name: Elite Guardian
levels.subtitle: Tool bag with a sock-grabbing arm
levels.hat: Soft cap with a sock-grabbing mechanical arm
levels.cape: Quilted silver and blue capelet with red trim
levels.prop: Tool bag with a sock-grabbing arm
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: The short arm on the hat and the long arm in the bag both specialize in socks.

levels.name: Alliance Captain
levels.subtitle: Bucket of mop and cleaning tools
levels.hat: Captain's cap with mop fringe
levels.cape: Red and blue capelet with cleaning-cloth fringe
levels.prop: Bucket of mop and cleaning tools
levels.motion: A cream line drifts down beside the small brush.
levels.story: Mop strands become a captain's plume, and heroic gear becomes a bucket of cleaning tools.

levels.name: Dawn Watcher
levels.subtitle: Washing-machine bag dispensing a long sock
levels.hat: Towel crown with a long sock
levels.cape: Blue capelet with a fleece collar and two pegs
levels.prop: Washing-machine bag dispensing a long sock
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: The towel crown holds down one long sock while the portable washer sends out another.

levels.name: Legendary Guardian
levels.subtitle: Jam jar opened with a giant peg
levels.hat: Jam-jar rescue hat with an open lid
levels.cape: Cream, red and blue capelet with a clothes peg
levels.prop: Jam jar opened with a giant peg
levels.motion: Three warm stars appear by the thank-you banner; the original blue input glow remains.
levels.story: The hat lid finally opens, and a giant peg and rope pry open the jam jar.

wuxia.name: Wandering Hero
wuxia.title: Every good deed earns a better reputation and a longer noodle-shop bill. In the end, treating friends to a meal becomes the ultimate skill.

levels.name: Mountain-School Novice
levels.subtitle: Empty woven bowl and large wooden spoon
levels.hat: Patched headscarf with an orange knot
levels.cape: Cream capelet with a teal collar and orange knot
levels.prop: Empty woven bowl and large wooden spoon
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: A large orange knot tops the patched scarf; the wooden spoon outshines the empty bowl.

levels.name: Bamboo-Grove Youth
levels.subtitle: Bamboo tube hiding a steamed bun
levels.hat: Soft leaf-shaped hat with a bamboo tube
levels.cape: Cream capelet with teal trim and a bamboo clasp
levels.prop: Bamboo tube hiding a steamed bun
levels.motion: Two small apricot lines glow beside the lunchbox lid, without sound.
levels.story: The leaf hat carries a bamboo tube, and the travel tube hides a steamed bun.

levels.name: Wandering Adventurer
levels.subtitle: Bamboo-framed map of noodle stops
levels.hat: Straw hat with a noodle-shop map
levels.cape: Gray and teal capelet with a map pocket
levels.prop: Bamboo-framed map of noodle stops
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: Both the hat map and the framed route chart mark only noodle bowls.

levels.name: Roving Swordsman
levels.subtitle: Bamboo sword sheath with a wooden spoon
levels.hat: Bent-tip conical hat with a wooden spoon
levels.cape: Teal capelet with rolled edges and an orange knot
levels.prop: Bamboo sword sheath with a wooden spoon
levels.motion: A tiny warm-colored soup drop glows at the sheath opening.
levels.story: A spoon decorates the bent hat, and another peeks out of the bamboo sword sheath.

levels.name: Bamboo Swordsman
levels.subtitle: Carried noodle bowl with trailing noodles
levels.hat: Tilted conical hat tied with noodle cord
levels.cape: Cream and teal capelet with long ties
levels.prop: Carried noodle bowl with trailing noodles
levels.motion: A question-mark curl of steam briefly fades in above the bowl.
levels.story: Thick noodle cord wraps the hat while noodles hang over the carried bowl.

levels.name: Renowned Wanderer
levels.subtitle: Noodle bowl surrounded by bills
levels.hat: Soft rolled hat with noodle-shop bills
levels.cape: Deep teal capelet with a large pocket
levels.prop: Noodle bowl surrounded by bills
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: Bills wrap around both hat and bowl. The noodle kit keeps getting bigger.

levels.name: Master of the Breeze
levels.subtitle: Vinegar pot and noodle bowl
levels.hat: Wind-swept conical hat with a vinegar pot
levels.cape: Wind-folded cream capelet with teal trim
levels.prop: Vinegar pot and noodle bowl
levels.motion: A short green breeze line slides beside the vinegar bottle, then stops.
levels.story: A tiny vinegar pot hangs from the hat; its companion seasons the noodle bowl.

levels.name: Hero of the Land
levels.subtitle: Map weighed down by a noodle bowl
levels.hat: Fan-shaped conical hat with a noodle map
levels.cape: Deep teal capelet with cream cloud trim
levels.prop: Map weighed down by a noodle bowl
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: A noodle map opens on the hat, while a noodle bowl pins down the route chart.

levels.name: A Living Legend
levels.subtitle: Shared noodle bowl with many spoons
levels.hat: Soft conical hat with a large noodle-cord knot
levels.cape: Cream and teal capelet with a large orange knot
levels.prop: Shared noodle bowl with many spoons
levels.motion: Three warm curls of steam fade in above the shared platter, one after another.
levels.story: A grand soft hat is tied with noodle cord. Many spoons gather around one bowl to share.

baker.name: Sweet Bakery
baker.title: The dough has never liked following instructions. It eventually becomes the bakery's biggest star, with all the fun in the food and tools.

levels.name: Kitchen Helper
levels.subtitle: Flour sack with a bread snail
levels.hat: Patched cream chef's hat
levels.cape: Patched pink capelet
levels.prop: Flour sack with a bread snail
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: A patched chef's hat meets a bread snail peeking from the flour sack.

levels.name: Cookie Apprentice
levels.subtitle: Basket with an enormous croissant
levels.hat: Soft pink croissant hat
levels.cape: Pink and white checked capelet
levels.prop: Basket with an enormous croissant
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: A soft croissant hat pairs with a croissant that fills the entire basket.

levels.name: Bread Baker
levels.subtitle: Mixing bowl overflowing with cream
levels.hat: Chef's hat with a pointed cream swirl
levels.cape: Capelet with cream scallops and a pink bow
levels.prop: Mixing bowl overflowing with cream
levels.motion: The domed dough gently puffs up once, then rests.
levels.story: The hat has a cream peak; the bowl has a whole cream mountain.

levels.name: Cake Baker
levels.subtitle: Basket overflowing with dough
levels.hat: Puffed-dough chef's hat
levels.cape: Buttoned capelet with flour spots
levels.prop: Basket overflowing with dough
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: The hat has overproofed, and the dough is climbing out of its basket.

levels.name: Pastry Chef
levels.subtitle: Breakfast bucket stacked with pancakes
levels.hat: Strawberry-pancake chef's hat
levels.cape: Pink capelet with sprinkles
levels.prop: Breakfast bucket stacked with pancakes
levels.motion: A cream star appears beside the whisk; the dough keeps its expression even at rest.
levels.story: A strawberry-pancake hat accompanies a breakfast stacked much too high.

levels.name: Chocolatier
levels.subtitle: Mixing bowl full of bread snails
levels.hat: Bread-snail chef's hat
levels.cape: Cream capelet with fine pink trim
levels.prop: Mixing bowl full of bread snails
levels.motion: One mold cavity glows warmly, then settles.
levels.story: One bread snail rests on the hat while its friends fill the mixing bowl.

levels.name: Sugar Artist
levels.subtitle: Basket of strawberry jelly
levels.hat: Cherry-jelly chef's hat
levels.cape: Quilted pink capelet with a cherry clasp
levels.prop: Basket of strawberry jelly
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: A jelly hat comes with a delightfully wobbly strawberry pudding.

levels.name: Celebrated Pastry Chef
levels.subtitle: Basket carrying a strawberry party cake
levels.hat: Strawberry cream-cake hat
levels.cape: Cream capelet with a large pink bow
levels.prop: Basket carrying a strawberry party cake
levels.motion: The display light flashes once; a breathing arc appears beside the sleeping dough.
levels.story: A cream-cake hat and a celebration cake ready to travel.

levels.name: Master Patisserie Chef
levels.subtitle: Fish-biscuit basket with one burnt biscuit
levels.hat: Chef's hat with fish-biscuit fan pleats
levels.cape: Cream capelet with a fish-biscuit clasp
levels.prop: Fish-biscuit basket with one burnt biscuit
levels.motion: Three groups of warm dots glow along the tray; the sleepy dough never wakes.
levels.story: A master's fish-biscuit hat, with one burnt biscuit saved for yourself.

garden.name: Four Seasons Garden
garden.title: The more skilled the gardener becomes, the more jobs the plants find to assign. By the end, every season has a devoted caretaker.

levels.name: Seed Keeper
levels.subtitle: Seed bag with an enormous sprout
levels.hat: Worn-brim straw hat with a crooked sprout
levels.cape: Patched olive-green capelet
levels.prop: Seed bag with an enormous sprout
levels.motion: A yellow earth-colored dot glows beside the label.
levels.story: A crooked sprout on the hat meets a giant sprout emerging from the seed bag.

levels.name: Budding Gardener
levels.subtitle: Watering-can basket under a leaf umbrella
levels.hat: Straw sunhat shaded by a large leaf
levels.cape: Green capelet with a leaf collar
levels.prop: Watering-can basket under a leaf umbrella
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: A big leaf shelters the hat, while a little leaf shelters the watering can.

levels.name: Flowerbed Keeper
levels.subtitle: Potted plant and ceramic snail
levels.hat: Straw hat with a snail shell
levels.cape: Green capelet with straps and a pocket
levels.prop: Potted plant and ceramic snail
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: A snail hat and a ceramic snail keep a slowly growing plant company.

levels.name: Florist Apprentice
levels.subtitle: Watering can watering itself
levels.hat: Soft watering-can hat with a daisy
levels.cape: Deep green rain cape with a water-drop clasp
levels.prop: Watering can watering itself
levels.motion: The outermost flower in the bouquet dips once.
levels.story: The watering-can hat comes with a can that waters itself.

levels.name: All-Season Gardener
levels.subtitle: Self-watering seedling pot
levels.hat: Straw hat with pegged leaves
levels.cape: Beige capelet with a daisy clasp
levels.prop: Self-watering seedling pot
levels.motion: Four planning cards glow out of step; the last is half a beat late.
levels.story: Pegs hold leaves into a hat brim while a seedling waters itself.

levels.name: Greenhouse Keeper
levels.subtitle: Basket bursting with mushrooms
levels.hat: Straw hat covered by a red mushroom
levels.cape: Leaf-patterned capelet with a mushroom clasp
levels.prop: Basket bursting with mushrooms
levels.motion: Two mint mist dots fade from the outer nozzle, away from the cat's face.
levels.story: One mushroom covers the hat; another fills the carrying basket.

levels.name: Garden Designer
levels.subtitle: Lotus bowl holding a giant dewdrop
levels.hat: Soft leaf hat with a dewdrop
levels.cape: Capelet of layered green leaves
levels.prop: Lotus bowl holding a giant dewdrop
levels.motion: No additional animation.
levels.story: A dewdrop hat pairs with a lotus bowl holding one enormous drop.

levels.name: Head Gardener
levels.subtitle: Basket with a plump pumpkin
levels.hat: Straw hat with a plump pumpkin
levels.cape: Wheat-colored capelet with a leaf knot
levels.prop: Basket with a plump pumpkin
levels.motion: A pale yellow ring gently appears along the wooden-stamp umbrella's edge.
levels.story: A pumpkin hat and a pumpkin so plump it stretches its basket.

levels.name: Master of Gardens
levels.subtitle: Sunflower and seedling backpack
levels.hat: Large leaf hat with a sunflower
levels.cape: Layered leaf capelet with a yellow flower clasp
levels.prop: Sunflower and seedling backpack
levels.motion: A dot glows on each seasonal flower; a breathing arc fades quietly beside the snail.
levels.story: A sunflower rests on the brim, and one more seedling grows in the backpack.

performer.name: Music Stage
performer.title: From bedroom practice to the grandest stage, the original row of clothes-peg fans still sits in front. The show gets bigger; the cat stays calm.

levels.name: Bedroom Trainee
levels.subtitle: Comb microphone held by a peg
levels.hat: Purple-bow headscarf with a clothes peg
levels.cape: Light purple capelet with cream trim
levels.prop: Comb microphone held by a peg
levels.motion: No additional animation.
